scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:contract && npm -w @3f/frontend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @3f/contract run typecheck && npm -w @3f/backend run typecheck && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.lint:frontend: eslint --config eslint.config.mjs "frontend/app/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" frontend/next.config.ts frontend/postcss.config.mjs frontend/tailwind.config.ts frontend/vitest.config.ts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.lint: eslint --config eslint.config.mjs "backend/src/**/*.ts" "backend/test/**/*.ts" "contract/src/**/*.ts" "contract/test/**/*.ts" eslint.config.mjs "tools/**/*.mjs" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format:check:frontend: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check "frontend/app/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,md}" "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" frontend/package.json frontend/tsconfig.json frontend/next.config.ts frontend/postcss.config.mjs frontend/tailwind.config.ts frontend/vitest.config.ts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.format:check: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --ignore-path .prettierignore --check "backend/src/**/*.ts" "backend/test/**/*.ts" "contract/src/**/*.ts" "contract/test/**/*.ts" package.json backend/package.json contract/package.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows/quality.yml "tools/**/*.mjs" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && npm run format:check:frontend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:hermetic: npm -w @3f/contract run test && npm -w @3f/backend run test:hermetic && npm run test:frontend && node --test tools/quality-gate.test.mjs
scripts.verify:ci: npm run structural && npm run typecheck && npm run quality && npm run test:hermetic
